search_aliases: Marriott SoMa Mission Bay Hotel (2018 working name)
summary: A 299-room hotel at 100 Channel Street designed by Hornberger + Worstell, which Potrero View reports opened in June 2022 as Mission Bay's first hotel after a March 2018 groundbreaking by developer Lawrence Lui (SOMA Hotel, a Stanford Hotel affiliate per Hoodline). A review published February 24, 2023 says the rooftop bar Cavaña opened on the 17th floor in late January 2023.

milestones.text: Department of Building Inspection new-construction permit application 201509227707 filed to erect a 17-story, 250-room hotel with no basement at 100 Channel St (estimated cost $60,000,000)

Groundbreaking ceremony with Mayor Mark Farrell for the hotel, then called Marriott SoMa Mission Bay, scheduled to open in 2020; Potrero View later wrote that the Marriott chain was never part of actual plans
LUMA Hotel opens at 100 Channel Street, Mission Bay's first hotel

Potrero View (September 2022) reports the 17th-floor Sky Lounge rooftop bar planned to debut in the fall (a planned, not an actual, date); the hotel's June 28, 2022 opening release had said the lounge was 'set to open later this summer'; no source read says when or whether it opened

open_questions: Hospitality Net's opening announcement (cited in the map note) could not be read (access refused); its release is listed with the date July 4, 2022, which could not be checked. The opening month comes from Potrero View alone (article dated September 2022: 'In June, LUMA Hotel opened').

The hotel's June 28, 2022 opening release says 'Designed by Cole Martinez Curtis & Associates' but does not say what part of the design that covers; the architect named by Potrero View and the San Francisco Chronicle is Hornberger + Worstell, and no source read names an interior designer.
Construction cost, and why the opening moved from the 2020 target to 2022, are not stated in any source read.

The Department of Building Inspection shows the new-construction permit completed on 2024-05-07, long after the June 2022 opening; this is a permit closeout date and is not used as the completion date.
